text: When the body is relaxed, the brain perceives information differently: it sinks more easily into the unconscious and is processed worse. Make it a rule: read news, heavy texts, and conflictual correspondence in one place, at the same limited time, and only sitting on a chair or in a simple office armchair (that is, do this at work). And leave the armchair, sofa, and bed at home for rest, dreams, sleep, and intimacy. After just two weeks you will feel that your anxiety level has decreased, intrusive thoughts go away, you rest better, and you act more effectively.
